list_style.description: Optional list layout tokens (marker box, indentation, and marker strings).

marker_box_width_pt.description: Fixed-width marker box in 1/1000 pt units.

marker_gap_pt.description: Gap between marker box and body text start in 1/1000 pt units.

depth_indent_pt.description: Additional indent per nesting depth level in 1/1000 pt units.

marker_align.description: Alignment of the marker within the fixed-width marker box.

number_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the number marker (e.g. '.' yields '1.').

palette.description: Named colors. The only color table; roles and primitives reference these keys or hex.

primitives.description: Named visual atoms referenced by role/variant box_decoration.

surfaces.description: Named fills used for backgrounds and surfaces.

shadows.description: Named compound shadows (one or more layers).

corners.description: Named corner radii in 1/1000 pt units.

roles.description: Role -> base style mapping. Must include 'default' with font_family, font_size, line_height_mult, and color. Other roles inherit omitted text fields from default.

letter_spacing_pt.description: Extra advance between glyphs in 1/1000 pt (may be negative). Default 0.

first_line_indent_pt.description: First-line indent in 1/1000 pt. Applies only to the first wrapped line of a text node.

text_align.description: Text alignment within the text box.

self_align.description: Overrides the parent container's cross-axis alignment for this item.

image_fit.description: How an image node's bitmap maps into its laid-out box. contain (default) letterboxes; cover center-crops. Lives on the role/variant, never on the node.

box_decoration.description: Optional box decoration for any node using this role (text, table, container, image). Lives on the role, never on the node. Text badges: background + padding + corner_radius on the role.

list_style.description: Optional list layout tokens for this role.

variants.description: Variant name -> skin for this role. Keys: box_decoration, self_align, text_overrides, list_style, image_fit. Text fields (bold, color, text_align, font_size, …) go in text_overrides, not at the variant root.

self_align.description: Overrides the parent container's cross-axis alignment for this item.

text_overrides.description: Optional text patch (bold, color, text_align, font_size, …). Not valid at the variant root.

list_style.description: Optional list layout token overrides for this role variant.

image_fit.description: How an image node's bitmap maps into its laid-out box. contain (default) letterboxes; cover center-crops.

font_aliases.description: Role font_family names -> embedded font file stems under assets/fonts/ (e.g. 'Roboto-Regular' -> 'Roboto-Regular'). Lives in styles/theme.json, not manifest.json. One face also registers as 'default'; two or more faces: alias every stem, no auto-default.

font_faces.description: Optional family name -> {regular,bold,italic,bold_italic} file stems. Role font_family names this family; bold/italic then select those files. Omitted slots stay synthetic (stroke/shear). Not CSS font-weight numbers. Lives in styles/theme.json.

precedence.description: Modifier type precedence list (low -> high). Higher precedence overrides lower precedence on overlap.
